summary: A new story series, The Night Desk: eight stick-figure stories about Ruth, the night clerk at the Starlite Motel, each with its own locked prompt and code checks so every one stands alone. It isn't in the daily mix yet; it waits for your choice of how it goes out.
frontend: Nothing changes on the Vault page yet. Once the series is on, its Reels show in History as The Night Desk with their episode number.
other: pipeline/series/night-desk.md holds the series rules, Ruth's and the motel's look, and a brief for each of the 8 stories (locked ending, guest, beats, key drawings, traps, caption vote).

New checks for every Night Desk Reel: the first lines say who Ruth is and where, she keeps her round glasses in every drawing, the guest's marker is drawn, it ends the way its brief locks it, no other story is mentioned, and the caption has #TheNightDesk. "Part" and "episode" stay banned.
reels.yml can make one by hand (format series, with an episode number), posting nothing when post is off. LIVE_SERIES puts it in the fifth daily slot once you choose.
